name: Golden Gate
description: Fibonacci-spaced gates — successive ratios approach φ

sections.heading: Sound
items: Fibonacci gaps (1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13…) between hits; deeper depth = sparser rhythm
Reverse plays this cycle’s gaps backwards (not the whole table from max)
Pitch modes: 1V/oct on the jack; MIDI chromatic Fibonacci or near-φ intervals with pitch bend

sections.heading: Gestures
items: Button + Fader — Speed (Heat Pump grid); overrides Configurator Speed
Shift + short — Reverse gap order (Button LED white↔off fade)
Shift + long — Cycle output mode: Note → CC → 12-TET pitch → φ pitch

sections.heading: LEDs
items: Top — Cycle progress (app color); red cycle length while Shift held; speed division while Button held
Button — Output mode color; white↔off on reverse; off when muted

channels.jackDescription: Note and CC modes: gate pulse. Pitch modes: 1V/oct CV (MIDI note in parallel).
channels.faderDescription: How far into 1, 1, 2, 3, 5 … 89 the gaps go — shallow = denser, deep = sparser.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: How many steps before the pattern wraps (about 8–128).
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Clock division (same as Heat Pump): 1/1, 1/2, 1/4., 1/4, 1/8., 1/4T, 1/8, 1/8T, 1/16, 1/32. Up = faster. Overrides the Speed parameter.
channels.fnDescription: Short press: restart at the downbeat. Long press: mute (do not move the fader).
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Short: reverse this cycle’s gaps. Long: cycle Note → CC → 12-TET pitch → φ pitch.
channels.ledTopPlusShift: Cycle length (red) while Shift is held
channels.ledTopPlusFn: Speed division: cyan = straight, yellow = dotted, orange = triplet
